items.title: 67520_George Handy oral history interview
items.q: Hamp said, I want you to meet George Handy, he's the guy that wrote those charts that we're so happy with

ctx.x:
I'll probably think of the name.
He was a well known, bigoted guy.
Anyway, he came into the room and Hamp said, I want you to meet George Handy, he's the guy that wrote those charts that we're so happy with and the guy said, terrific and Lionel said I want him to do about four or five things and the guy said yeah, great. He said, incidentally, what do you charge? I said well, the fact that we have a package here of four to five things, let me give you a decent price, say a hundred a chart, which was cheap, even…

that and that ended my writing for Hampton. I remember still being astonished of the fact that band leaders couldn't make their own decisions. I guess I wasn't willing to accept the fact that a band leader doesn't have control of his band.
